entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello, Sarah. I'm calling about an issue with my new VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.

Thank you, Alex. I have your account here. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical issue. The device is just not working correctly. It tracks my steps, but the main reason I bought it, the heart rate monitoring, is unreliable.
I see. And have you had any trouble connecting it to the VeloFit app?
Yes, exactly. It won't sync half the time. I've tried everything the website suggests, but it feels like the unit itself is broken. I think it might be defective.
I'm sorry to hear you're having that trouble. It definitely sounds frustrating. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay. I'm hoping we can work something out. If a full return isn't possible, maybe a discount on a replacement? I just want a product that works as advertised.

Thank you for your patience, Alex. Okay, I've checked our policy. I see the item was delivered 19 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. So we can absolutely process a full return for you.
Oh, really? That's great. I was prepared to troubleshoot or negotiate. That's much simpler.

Not a problem at all. Since you feel the item is defective, I'm happy to make this easy for you. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label now and sending it to the email address on file. Is that still a.chen@email.com?
Yes, that's the one. Thank you so much, Sarah. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
